equation_summary: Flash-KATA (the trained KATA-SPD path): causal score A[t,s] = Σ_g (scale·q_g[t]·k_g[s])² (concat-SPD; the kata_quadratic_sum variant uses Σ_{g,h}(q_g·k_h)²), all scores ≥ 0, future masked to 0, optional data-dependent offset gate (<q,k> + a_t·a_s)² and optional GDN-style decay A·exp(min(c_t − c_s, 0)); output o = (Σ_s A·v_s) / max(Σ_s A, 1-safe) — a positive squared-group-dot score with sum normalization (denominator tracked, no softmax, no epsilon in the kernel's safe-division). Optional qk-norm (rmsnorm or l2), RoPE (full-head or per-group), and short conv are external frontends. The psi-materialized paths route through FLA chunk/fused linear-attn kernels with normalize=True; a delta-rule erase variant (DeltaKATA) is a separate mixer.
state_shape: no fixed-size state in the flash quadratic path (standard KV cache of post-RoPE k/v for decode); psi-feature paths use an FLA linear-attn recurrent state; DeltaKATA uses the delta-rule state
gate_scope: none in the base score; optional data-dependent per-token/head offset gate (sigmoid) and optional data-dependent decay cumsum (separate blocked variants)
normalization: sum-of-scores denominator (b_acc), safe-divided by max(den, 1) in-kernel; no softmax
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM `E[QKV/grouping] ; B[K1 positive squared-group-dot normalized reducer] ; E[model output/cache]`: layer.py KataAttention.forward does external QKV/conv/qk-norm/RoPE/grouping, then the blocked reducer (parallel_kata_attn kernels: b_scores += (scale·qk_g)², causal-zero mask, o = ΣA·v / safe(ΣA), parallel_kata.py:154-232), then external RMSNorm + o_proj and KV cache update.

CONFIRM 'Exact source score, denominator and VJP': the reducer is positive and non-softmax with a plain-sum denominator — it is NOT the U1.S contract, so the B[K1 ...] axis blocker is correct; backward uses dA→2·qk·dA per group (parallel_kata.py:616-619).

CONFIRM 'optional polynomial U2 rewrite needs proof and state-size cost': the psi feature maps (spd_concat/spd_sum, feature_maps.py:29-129) materialize ⟨psi(q),psi(k)⟩ = Σ(q_g·k_g)² with qd = M·E(E+1)/2 (packed) or M·E² — a U2.A realization exists only through that polynomial feature expansion, whose state is quadratically larger than K2's [K,Dv] matrix and whose equality/normalization proof plus state-size cost are exactly what the ledger demands.
NOTE: concat vs sum score variants, offset gate, decay, and DeltaKATA erase are distinct blocked sub-equations; the admitted minimal case should be the plain masked concat-SPD normalized reducer.
